notes: Cash flow from Yahoo Finance's cash-flow statement (Operating Cash Flow; capex = Capital Expenditure, shown as a positive number). FCF = operating cash flow - capex. FCF QoQ / YoY only between two positive values.
FY25: diluted EPS from Yahoo's reported EPS where it matches net income / diluted shares, else net income / diluted shares (Yahoo's statements lack it).
PER and PBR convert the HKD share price into CNY at the month-end rate (Yahoo Finance FX).
Fiscal labels are the company's own fiscal year, named by the calendar year it ends in.

PER uses the trailing 4 quarters' diluted EPS (annual: the year's), ROA the trailing 4 quarters' net income over average total assets. EPS (GAAP, diluted) is the reported figure; EPS (adjusted) is Yahoo Finance's EPS on the analysts' basis (for US companies usually the company's adjusted, non-GAAP EPS; elsewhere usually the reported one), the basis of the (E) consensus. Each has its own QoQ / YoY, so a reported figure is never compared with an adjusted one.

Yahoo lists the adjusted EPS of the last 4 quarters only: each daily run records what it shows (market/history/financials_eps_adjusted.jsonl), so older quarters stay. A fiscal year's adjusted EPS is Yahoo's annual figure, else the sum of its four quarters when all four are known (listed in "derived"), else blank.
